extDescription.message: A new badge and name color with every Twitch message. Rainbow, pastel and pride flag palettes, plus pronouns and chat shortcuts.

welcomeLead.message: Every message you send on Twitch gets a new badge and a new name color.

welcomeStep1.message: Open any Twitch channel while signed in.

welcomeStep2.message: Look for the paw button below the chat box, next to the chat settings gear.

welcomeStep3.message: Rainbark walks you through a one-minute setup from there.

welcomeTip.message: The Rainbark button in your browser’s toolbar opens the panel on any Twitch tab.

welcomeUserscript.message: Used the Rainbark userscript before? Your settings carry over. Turn the userscript off so the two don’t run at once.

commandOpen.message: Open Rainbark on the Twitch tab you’re on
